messages:
deploy-bot: PROD deploy started • environment=prod • region=us-west-2 • tag=release/v3.5.0-rc2 • commit=9f3a2b7
alex.w: tagging note: this tag includes the memory-optimizations PR and the kv-cache fallback
maria.k: change window 01:00-03:00 UTC, rollback window until 02:00 if errors > 2% for 5m
alex.w: pin previous tag r3.4.2 available if rollback needed
sahil: any DB migration? I thought there was a small migration for shard metadata
maria.k: no DB schema changes. just config flag default=false. safe
jenna: release notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/v3.5.0-rc2 — highlights: lower p95, opt kernels
deploy-bot: canary traffic 5% -> checks running: latency, errors, token-cost
oncall-bot: alert: canary cluster inference-pool-3 showing +0.8s p95 spike at 1719532168
maria.k: saw that, investigating kernel selection fallback on g4dn nodes
alex.w: rolling back canary to 0% while we investigate :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: canary traffic -> 0% • canary pods scaled down
maria.k: root cause: a new kernel path triggers float->fp16 fallback on older drivers, pushing extra latency
sahil: plan: pin deployment to commit 7e2b0c4 (v3.5.0-rc1) across canary, keep prod hold
jenna: I'll update release notes and changelog to mark regression and mitigation steps
alex.w: ops checklist: create rollback PR, update tag pin in deploy config, notify customers in schedule
deploy-bot: rollback PR created: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/3421 • branch=hotfix/pin-rc1
maria.k: verified rollback on staging, smoke ok. recommend resume cutover after 20m of steady metrics
oncall-bot: metric check: p95 back to baseline at 1719532301
maria.k: proceeding to re-run canary at 5% with pin to 7e2b0c4
deploy-bot: canary traffic 5% -> checks running
alex.w: if all green, we'll promote to 50% then 100% with 10m observation windows
deploy-bot: PROD deploy completed (halted and pinned) • final_state=paused_for_investigation • active_tag=7e2b0c4 • duration=7m45s
maria.k: summary: deploy started -> detected p95 spike on canary -> pinned back to rc1 -> canary re-run. Next: monitor 30m then promote or fully rollback
jenna: published an internal postmortem draft in #postmortems in case we need
alex.w: thanks everyone — great catch. We'll reconvene in 15m if anything else shows up :thumbsup:
